name: Second player native Purge spawn
setup: Use a disposable dedicated Purge world with AllowSpawnNearFriend set as in the reported world. Join with a first real account and complete its truck start. Have a second account with no record for this world select a survivor profile and press Spawn while the first account stays connected.
expect: The joining client's native spawn position is the server's Purge roadside staging position for that player.
Neither native respawn chunk wait nor world readiness times out. Server logs PlayerSpawnedInWorld for the second client.
Both accounts receive distinct trucks. The second player leaves Building Environment in the driver seat and sees the Purge briefing once.
A returning account with a completed claim joins normally without a fresh starter truck or briefing.
followUp: Repeat with an incomplete Published claim left by a failed first entry. Reuse the same truck entity and finish the existing claim.
